subject: Intercompany invoice consolidation — delivery & remit flow
messages:
From: Susan Klein <susan.klein@heliohealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intercompany billing — single invoice vs separate entity docs

Hi Mateo,

Quick question as we finalize AP onboarding: HelioHealth has two legal entities that will be using Redwood (HelioHealth US and HelioHealth Europe). Our AP team prefers a single consolidated invoice for payment but tax needs require separate VAT/Tax breakdown per legal entity (and separate remit-to instructions).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
- Emit separate invoices per legal entity (different invoice numbers and remit-to bank details) while also sending a consolidated statement PDF to our corporate AP inbox for payment reconciliation?
- Push invoices to our SFTP (we can provide details) versus sending PDFs by email — any limitations on metadata (line-level VAT tags, entity id)?

If you can point me to a simple spec or example XML schema you support, that would be great. Attaching our AP onboarding template.

Thanks,
Susan Klein
Director, Finance Operations
HelioHealth Inc.

Attachment: AP_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (attachment referenced)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Susan Klein <susan.klein@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intercompany billing — single invoice vs separate entity docs

Thanks Susan — good question. Short answer: yes, we support both delivery patterns, but there are trade-offs. Outline below and a recommended path so we can scope the onboarding work.

Options:
1) Separate invoices per legal entity (recommended for tax/vat):
   - Each legal entity receives its own invoice PDF and invoice number.
   - Each invoice includes entity-specific VAT breakdown and remit-to bank/IBAN.
   - We can also emit a consolidated "statement" PDF that aggregates the line items across entities for your corporate AP. That statement is for reconciliation only (not a substitute for the legal invoices).

2) Single consolidated invoice (not ideal for EU VAT):
   - One invoice with per-line entity tags. This complicates payment and audit trails and may not meet local VAT document rules.

Delivery options:
- SFTP push: supports invoice PDF and e-invoice XML (we provide a flexible XML mapping). Recommended for machine ingest.
- Email: we can CC specific ops addresses with PDF copies. Good as a fallback or for smaller volumes.

Metadata / requirements:
- For SFTP/XML we need: entity_id, invoice_number, tax_id, VAT_breakdown lines, remit_to_id.
- For PDF via email we can embed a machine-readable XML alongside the PDF in the SFTP package or include a JSON metadata file.

Next steps (proposal):
- We prepare a short spec (XML + CSV mapping) and an SFTP sample payload for your team to test.
- Marissa will confirm billing contact and whether Helio wants the consolidated statement sent to a corporate mailbox (billing@heliohealth.com) in addition to the per-entity deliveries.
- Connor will scope SFTP ingestion and map our output to your AP system.

I'll attach a draft spec and proposed timeline (2 weeks for dev + test). If that works, please confirm billing contact(s) and whether Helio prefers a turn-up on SFTP first or email copies during the pilot.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Consolidated_Invoices_Spec.xlsx, helio_sftp-details.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Looping Marissa in as Sales Ops to capture the commercial implications and Connor for AP integration. A few notes from Sales Ops: 
- If Helio wants separate invoices per legal entity but a single payment, we need to record the payment allocation rules in the invoice footer so Finance can post properly.
- Pricing/discounting is contract-scoped to the HelioHealth US entity; if the EU entity is transacting separately we need a PO mapping.

Connor: can you confirm the SFTP filename conventions and whether we can include a CSV mapping that lists invoices and target remit_to IDs? I expect Helio will want both the XML and a human-friendly consolidated PDF.

I created a quick checklist for the pilot:
- Confirm AP mailbox (billing@heliohealth.com) and per-entity ops contacts
- Helio to provide SFTP credentials for a test folder + sample PO format
- Redwood to provide sample XML and PDF payloads for test
- Run two test invoices (one per entity) and a consolidated statement for reconciliation

I'll coordinate timelines with Helio after they confirm.

-Marissa
Sr. Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
